mapper.insert: insert into t_tm_stock (stock_date, material_code, stock_num, del_flag) select schedule_date, LEFT(cx3, 4), FLOOR(sum(tm4 * tm3) * 10) / 10, '0' from half_yc_import_bak where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and cx3 is not null and cx3 != '0' group by schedule_date, LEFT(cx3, 4) having sum(tm4 * tm3) > 0;

insert into t_tc_stock (stock_date, material_code, stock_num, del_flag) select schedule_date, CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')), FLOOR(sum(tc4 * tc3) * 10) / 10, '0' from half_yc_import_bak where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and tc1 is not null and tc1 != '0' group by schedule_date, CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')) having sum(tc4 * tc3) > 0
mapper.update: update t_tm_schedule_result r join (select LEFT(i.cx3, 4) tread_code, sum(IFNULL(i.tm9, 0) * i.tm3 + IFNULL(i.tm13, 0) * i.tm3 + IFNULL(i.tm17, 0) * i.tm3) night_plan_qty from half_yc_import_bak i where i.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and i.cx3 is not null and i.cx3 != '0' group by LEFT(i.cx3, 4)) i on r.tread_code = i.tread_code set r.night_plan_qty = i.night_plan_qty where r.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.insert: insert into t_tm_schedule_result (schedule_date, tread_code, DEL_FLAG, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) select i.schedule_date, LEFT(i.cx3, 4), '0', sum(IFNULL(i.tm9, 0) * i.tm3 + IFNULL(i.tm13, 0) * i.tm3 + IFNULL(i.tm17, 0) * i.tm3) night_plan_qty from half_yc_import_bak i where i.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and i.cx3 is not null and i.cx3 != '0' and not exists (select 0 from t_tm_schedule_result r where r.schedule_date = i.schedule_date and r.tread_code = LEFT(i.cx3, 4)) group by i.schedule_date, LEFT(i.cx3, 4) having sum(IFNULL(i.tm9, 0) * i.tm3 + IFNULL(i.tm13, 0) * i.tm3 + IFNULL(i.tm17, 0) * i.tm3) > 0
mapper.update: update t_tc_schedule_result r join (select CONCAT(LEFT(i.tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')) sidewall_code, sum(IFNULL(i.tc9, 0) * i.tc3 + IFNULL(i.tc13, 0) * i.tc3) night_plan_qty from half_yc_import_bak i where i.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and i.tc1 is not null and i.tc1 != '0' group by CONCAT(LEFT(i.tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', ''))) i on r.sidewall_code = i.sidewall_code set r.night_plan_qty = i.night_plan_qty where r.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.insert: insert into t_tc_schedule_result (schedule_date, sidewall_code, DEL_FLAG, NIGHT_PLAN_QTY) select i.schedule_date, CONCAT(LEFT(i.tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')), '0', sum(IFNULL(i.tc9, 0) * i.tc3 + IFNULL(i.tc13, 0) * i.tc3) night_plan_qty from half_yc_import_bak i where i.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and i.tc1 is not null and i.tc1 != '0' and not exists (select 0 from t_tc_schedule_result r where r.schedule_date = i.schedule_date and r.sidewall_code = CONCAT(LEFT(i.tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', ''))) group by i.schedule_date, CONCAT(LEFT(i.tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')) having sum(IFNULL(i.tc9, 0) * i.tc3 + IFNULL(i.tc13, 0) * i.tc3) > 0

insert into t_tm_month_plan_surplus(year, month, material_code, month_plan_qty, month_finish_qty, MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) select YEAR(now()), lpad(month(now()), 2, '0'), left(cx3, 4), ceil(sum(cx9 * tm2)), 0, ceil(sum(cx9 * tm2)) from half_yc_import_bak i where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and cx9 > 0 and not exists (select 0 from t_tm_month_plan_surplus t where t.year = YEAR(now()) and t.month = lpad(month(now()), 2, '0') and t.material_code = left(cx3, 4) and t.DEL_FLAG = '0') group by left(cx3, 4)
mapper.update: update t_tm_month_plan_surplus t join (select left(cx3, 4) material_code, ceil(sum(cx9 * tm2)) MONTH_REMAIN_QTY from half_yc_import_bak i where i.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and cx9 > 0 group by left(cx3, 4)) i on i.material_code = t.material_code set t.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY = i.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY, t.month_finish_qty = t.month_plan_qty - i.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY where t.year = YEAR(now()) and t.month = lpad(month(now()), 2, '0') and t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into t_tc_month_plan_surplus(year, month, material_code, month_plan_qty, month_finish_qty, MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) select YEAR(now()), lpad(month(now()), 2, '0'), CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')), ceil(sum(cx9 * tc2)), 0, ceil(sum(cx9 * tc2)) from half_yc_import_bak i where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and cx9 > 0 and not exists (select 0 from t_tc_month_plan_surplus t where t.year = YEAR(now()) and t.month = lpad(month(now()), 2, '0') and t.material_code = CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')) and t.DEL_FLAG = '0') group by CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', ''))
mapper.update: update t_tc_month_plan_surplus t join (select CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', '')) material_code, ceil(sum(cx9 * tc2)) MONTH_REMAIN_QTY from half_yc_import_bak i where i.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and cx9 > 0 group by CONCAT(LEFT(tc1, 6), IF(INSTR(cx3, 'VM') > 0, '(VMI)', ''))) i on i.material_code = t.material_code set t.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY = i.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY, t.month_finish_qty = t.month_plan_qty - i.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY where t.year = YEAR(now()) and t.month = lpad(month(now()), 2, '0') and t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select r.tread_code code, mi.machine_name machineName, r.day_plan_qty dayPlanQty, r.night_plan_qty nightPlanQty, r.next_day_plan_qty nextDayPlanQty, r.day_produce_order dayProduceOrder, r.night_produce_order nightProduceOrder, r.next_day_produce_order nextDayProduceOrder, ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value) curlLength, round(r.day_plan_qty / ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value), 1) dayPlanQtyRollNum, round(r.night_plan_qty / ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value), 1) nightPlanQtyRollNum, round(r.next_day_plan_qty / ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value), 1) nextDayPlanQtyRollNum from t_tm_schedule_result r left join t_tm_curl_roll cr on cr.tread_code = r.tread_code and cr.del_flag = '0' left join t_tm_params pa on pa.param_code = 'STANDARD_CRIMP_LENGTH' and pa.del_flag = '0' left join t_tm_machine_info mi on mi.id = r.machine_id and mi.del_flag = '0' where r.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and r.del_flag = '0' union select r.sidewall_code code, mi.machine_name machineName, r.day_plan_qty dayPlanQty, r.night_plan_qty nightPlanQty, r.next_day_plan_qty nextDayPlanQty, r.day_produce_order dayProduceOrder, r.night_produce_order nightProduceOrder, r.next_day_produce_order nextDayProduceOrder, ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value) curlLength, round(r.day_plan_qty / ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value), 1) dayPlanQtyRollNum, round(r.night_plan_qty / ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value), 1) nightPlanQtyRollNum, round(r.next_day_plan_qty / ifnull(cr.curl_length, pa.param_value), 1) nextDayPlanQtyRollNum from t_tc_schedule_result r left join t_tc_curl_roll cr on cr.sidewall_code = r.sidewall_code and cr.del_flag = '0' left join t_tc_params pa on pa.param_code = 'STANDARD_CRIMP_LENGTH' and pa.del_flag = '0' left join t_tc_machine_info mi on mi.id = r.machine_id and mi.del_flag = '0' where r.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and r.del_flag = '0'

select EMBRYO_CODE code, sum(IFNULL(CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) + IFNULL(CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0)) cx_plan_qty from t_cx_schedule_result where schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} and del_flag = '0' group by EMBRYO_CODE
